content: Citation UX is the trust surface of a RAG product and should get the same design care as answer text - readers spend more time hovering citations than re-reading paragraphs. Established pattern stack: (1) inline numbered superscript markers placed immediately after the clause they support, Perplexity/Bing style, with a source list below; (2) hover popover showing source title + exact snippet; (3) click deep-links into the source AND visually highlights the supporting span. The recurring complaint across open-webui, anything-llm, and others is precisely the missing third step: clicking a source does not jump to the exact location and the supporting text is not highlighted, which 'undermines trust in RAG-based answers'. Deep-link-with-highlight is the differentiator, not the citation marker itself.
